title: Your HSA Could Grow to $415K
description: The 2026 HSA limit is $4,400 for self-only coverage. Investing $4,400 a year for 30 years at a hypothetical 7% could grow to about $415K from $132K put in. Plans vary. Educational only, not financial advice. #hsa #personalfinance #shorts

title: Denied a US Visa 8 Times, Then He Built Zoom
description: Eric Yuan was refused a US visa eight times before getting in on his ninth try in 1997. In April 2019 Zoom went public and ended its first trading day worth about $16 billion. #zoom #entrepreneur #shorts
